explanation: Implemented all 11 B07 diagram edits using the pinned source and accepted canvas state. The updates add highlighted child-canvas composition, default mutation batching with flush/replay semantics, deduplicated checkpoint storage, bounded durable writes, and Agent Chat capability and runtime changes. All diagrams fit their scaffold rectangles; Projection has exactly 30 concept lines and Chat Overview exactly 42. Positions remain null and edges retain the specified order. Shared checkpoint encoding supports later saved views and contexts, while Projection retains its identity for later generalized inputs; those later features are not depicted as implemented.
